Even at $1/7$ the budget, AdaCodec with 32k tokens surpasses the 224k baseline on all long-video benchmarks; on five general-video benchmarks, it raises the average score while substantially cutting time-to-first-token from 9.26s to 1.62s.

</details>


### [204] [STaR-KV: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting for KV Cache Compression in GUI Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01790)
*Yuhang Han,Wenzheng Yang,Yujie Chen,Xiangqi Jin,Yaojie Zhang,Siteng Huang,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对视觉语言模型GUI代理中KV缓存随交互步骤线性增长导致的显存瓶颈，提出STaR-KV无训练压缩框架，通过子空间感知评分、时间稳定性折扣和熵驱动温度自适应重塑token重要性，在四个GUI基准上达到同类最优压缩效果，峰值显存降低近40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GUI代理中KV缓存随交互步骤线性增长，例如UI-TARS-1.5-7B在仅5张截图上就消耗76 GB显存，逼近主流80 GB加速器容量上限。现有KV压缩方法存在两个错误的结构性假设：将视觉token重要性聚合为单一共享显著性图，以及对融合分数分布应用固定top-B截断。实验证明注意力子空间存在空间特化且跨层迁移，分数分布形状沿轨迹漂移。

Method: 提出STaR-KV（时空自适应重加权）框架，沿三个维度校准token重要性：(i) 基于在线空间互信息的子空间感知评分；(ii) 时间稳定性折扣，抑制持续被关注的子空间中的冗余缓存条目；(iii) 熵导出温度，自适应重塑分数分布。该方法无需训练。

Result: 在四个GUI基准上，STaR-KV在匹配压缩预算下达到最强平均准确率，无压缩阶段FLOPs开销（-0.07%），在20% KV缓存预算下峰值GPU显存降低近40%。

Conclusion: STaR-KV通过打破现有KV压缩方法的两大错误假设，实现了高效的训练无关压缩，显著缓解了GUI代理部署中的显存瓶颈问题。

Abstract: Vision-language-model-based graphical user interface (GUI) agents have shown broad automation capabilities, yet deployment is bottlenecked by a key-value (KV) cache that grows linearly with interaction steps. For instance, UI-TARS-1.5-7B consumes 76 GB of GPU memory on merely five screenshots, approaching the capacity of mainstream 80 GB accelerators. Existing KV compression methods share two structural assumptions: aggregating visual-token importance into a single shared saliency map, and applying a fixed top-B cutoff to the fused score distribution. Pilot measurements refute both: spatial specialization lives at the attention-subspace level and migrates across layers, while the score distribution drifts in shape along a trajectory. We propose STaR-KV (Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting), a training-free KV cache compression framework that calibrates token importance along three axes: (i) subspace-aware scoring driven by online spatial mutual information; (ii) a temporal stability discount that suppresses redundant cache entries from persistently attended subspaces; and (iii) an entropy-derived temperature that adaptively reshapes the score distribution. Across four GUI benchmarks, STaR-KV achieves the strongest average accuracy among state-of-the-art KV compression methods (e.g., GUIKV, SnapKV) at matched budgets, with no compression-stage FLOPs overhead (-0.07%) and cutting peak GPU memory by nearly 40% at a 20% KV-cache budget. Code is available at https://github.com/kawhiiiileo/STaR-KV.

</details>


### [205] [Personalized 3D Myocardial Infarct Geometry Reconstruction from Cine MRI for Cardiac Digital Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01808)
*Yilin Lyu,Mark YY Chan,Ching-Hui Sia,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于显式几何-运动嵌入的模型，可直接从多视角电影MRI中全自动重建个性化、可用于仿真的3D心肌梗死几何结构，在225例数据上平均Dice达0.678，下游电生理仿真结果与LGE金标准高度一致，无需造影剂即可实现梗死表征，可无缝集成到心脏数字孪生建模中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确的三维心肌梗死几何表征对构建心脏数字孪生以精确模拟梗死相关电生理至关重要。LGE MRI虽是临床金标准，但依赖造影剂，限制了肾功能受损患者的使用和长期随访。因此，亟需一种无造影剂的方法来重建MI几何结构。

Method: 1) 构建4D（3D+t）双心室网格，显式提取和解耦几何感知与运动感知特征；2) 设计双分支模块实现自适应几何-运动融合，捕捉时空依赖关系以映射梗死区域；3) 引入多尺度监督，利用AHA-17节段引导的交叉注意力机制指导预测，确保生物物理一致的重建。

Result: 在225例电影MRI上，3D MI重建平均Dice为0.678±0.011；下游在体电生理仿真评估中，结果与LGE金标准高度一致。

Conclusion: 该模型无需造影剂即可实现高质量的心肌梗死三维几何重建，在电生理仿真验证中表现优异，有望无缝集成到心脏数字孪生建模中，为肾功能受损患者和长期随访提供可行方案。

Abstract: Accurate 3D geometric characterization of myocardial infarction (MI) is essential for building cardiac digital twins (CDTs) to precisely simulate infarct-related electrophysiology. Late gadolinium enhancement magnetic resonance imaging (LGE MRI) is the clinical reference for locating MI, yet its reliance on contrast agents restricts use in renally impaired patients and limits longitudinal follow-ups. As an alternative, contrast-free cine MRI visualizes abnormal ventricular wall motion, which is highly indicative of the infarcted area. In this study, we propose a novel explicit geometry-motion embedded model to fully automatically reconstruct personalized, simulation-ready 3D MI geometries directly from multi-view cine MRIs. Specifically, we construct a 4D (3D + t) biventricular mesh to explicitly extract and decouple geometry-aware and motion-aware features. We further design a dual-branch module for adaptive geometry-motion fusion to capture spatiotemporal dependencies for mapping infarcted region. Furthermore, we introduce multi-scale supervision utilizing an AHA-17 segment-guided cross-attention mechanism to steer the prediction, ensuring biophysically consistent reconstruction. Experimental results on 225 cine MRIs demonstrated that the proposed 3D MI reconstruction achieved high performance with an average Dice score of 0.678 $\pm$ 0.011. In the downstream in-silico electrophysiological simulation evaluations, the results were highly consistent with the LGE-derived ground truth, highlighting the great potential of the proposed model for contrast-free scar characterization and seamless integration into CDT modeling. The code will be released publicly upon acceptance of the manuscript for publication.

</details>


### [206] [Unsupervised Collaborative Domain Adaptation for Driving Scene Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01818)
*Jiahe Fan,Shaolong Shu,Mingjian Sun,Tiehua Zhang,Bohong Xiao,Hanli Wang,Rui Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无监督协作域自适应（UCDA）框架，用于无源场景下的驾驶场景解析，通过整合多个预训练源模型的互补知识，在无需原始源数据的情况下提升目标域场景解析的可靠性与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无源无监督域自适应方法通常依赖单一预训练源模型，导致感知系统易受源特定偏差影响，在多样化的道路布局、光照、天气和交通条件下鲁棒性受限。

Method: UCDA构建类级原型记忆库，通过原型相似性估计跨模型预测可靠性以融合多个源模型；采用两阶段迁移策略：先通过正负一致性约束对多个源模型进行协同优化，再将验证后的专家知识蒸馏到单一可部署的目标模型中。

Result: 在公开驾驶场景数据集和真实自动驾驶平台数据上的综合评估表明，UCDA有效整合了多源互补知识，显著提升了目标域场景解析的可靠性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: UCDA框架通过多源协作与知识蒸馏，在无源域数据访问限制下实现了更鲁棒的驾驶场景解析，适用于开放动态的自动驾驶环境。

Abstract: Reliable driving scene parsing is a fundamental capability for autonomous vehicles operating in open and dynamic driving environments. However, adapting perception models to new deployment domains remains challenging because pixel-level annotations are expensive to obtain, while source-domain data are often inaccessible due to privacy, security, or ownership constraints. Existing source-free unsupervised domain adaptation methods typically rely on a single pre-trained source model, which makes the adapted perception system vulnerable to source-specific biases and limits its robustness under diverse road layouts, illumination conditions, weather patterns, and traffic conditions. This article presents an unsupervised collaborative domain adaptation (UCDA) framework for driving scene parsing in a source-free setting, which transfers complementary knowledge from multiple pre-trained source models to a unified target model without accessing any original source samples. To compare predictions from independently trained models, UCDA constructs a class-level prototype memory bank and estimates cross-model prediction reliability through prototype similarity, reducing the effect of inconsistent confidence scales across source models. Based on the resulting complementary supervision, UCDA adopts a two-stage transfer strategy: multiple source models are first refined on unlabeled target-domain driving data through collaborative optimization with positive and negative consistency constraints, and their validated expertise is then distilled into a single deployable target model. Comprehensive evaluations on public driving-scene datasets and real-world data collected from an autonomous vehicle platform demonstrate that UCDA effectively consolidates complementary multi-source knowledge, improving target-domain scene parsing reliability and generalization across diverse driving environments.

</details>


### [207] [Hist2Style: Histogram-Guided Stylization with Bilateral Grids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01819)
*Dekel Galor,Adam Pikielny,Zhoutong Zhang,Ke Wang,Laura Waller,Jiawen Chen,Ilya Chugunov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Hist2Style提出了一种基于双边网格的快速边缘感知风格迁移方法，通过从大型图像编辑模型中蒸馏知识到轻量级网络，利用直方图嵌入实现可交互的高分辨率真实感风格化，避免了幻觉并支持实时用户控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大型图像模型虽然能实现外观编辑，但计算开销大、存在幻觉问题且用户控制有限，不适合高分辨率实时工作流。

Method: 采用双边网格公式实现快速边缘感知风格化，将操作约束为双边空间中的局部仿射变换；从大型图像编辑模型蒸馏到轻量级网络；使用语言和视觉语言模型生成的大规模监督语料训练；基于直方图的风格目标嵌入提供可解释的用户交互接口。

Result: 该方法保持内容结构、避免幻觉、支持实时高分辨率真实感风格化，并允许用户交互式控制颜色和色调调整。

Conclusion: Hist2Style通过双边网格约束和知识蒸馏，在保持视觉保真度的同时实现了高效、可控的真实感风格迁移，解决了现有方法在计算效率和用户控制方面的不足。

Abstract: Photorealistic style transfer aims to match the color and tone of an input image to that of a style target while preserving the content and details of the original scene. Although existing large image models can facilitate these kinds of appearance edits, their high computational demands, potential for hallucinations, and limited user control make them unsuitable for high-resolution, real-time workflows. We introduce Hist2Style, a bilateral-grid formulation for fast, edge-aware stylization that preserves visual fidelity by constraining operations to locally affine transforms in bilateral space. Our model distills a large image editing model into a lightweight network by training on a large supervised corpus generated with language and vision-language models, targeting spatially varying color edits. The network conditions on a histogram-based embedding of the style target to provide an interpretable interface for adjusting the output style by modifying the target color distribution. Overall, Hist2Style maintains content structure by construction, avoids hallucinations, and supports real-time, high-resolution photorealistic stylization with interactive user-controllable color and tone adjustments.

</details>


### [208] [Hierarchically Decoupled Mixture-of-Experts for Robust Traffic Sign Recognition in Complex Driving Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01822)
*Mingxiao Wang,Xiaozhen Qu,Bolin Gao,Tong Wang,Lei He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CBDES MoE TSR框架，通过层次化解耦的异构混合专家模型实现交通标志的动态路由检测，在提升精度2.3%的同时降低39.4%计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交通标志检测器依赖全局共享参数的静态推理，难以同时适应近处清晰样本和远处小目标、恶劣天气等挑战性场景，缺乏动态适应能力。

Method: 构建层次化解耦的异构混合专家(MoE)框架，包含异构YOLO专家池和轻量级门控网络，基于输入图像的语义特征实现图像级动态路由，选择性激活最合适的专家模型。

Result: 在复合交通标志数据集上mAP50-95达76.8%，较基线方法(74.5%)提升2.3%，同时计算开销降低约39.4%。

Conclusion: 所提方法在检测精度和效率之间取得了显著平衡，验证了从固定参数拟合到按需动态表示的转变的有效性。

Abstract: Traffic sign detection is a fundamental component of environmental perception in autonomous driving and intelligent transportation systems. However, most existing detectors rely on static inference with globally shared parameters, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse and unstructured traffic scenarios. As a result, a single static model often struggles to simultaneously handle both clear near-range samples and challenging conditions such as distant small targets or adverse weather environments. To address this limitation, we propose CBDES MoE TSR, a hierarchically decoupled heterogeneous mixture-of-experts(MoE) framework for traffic sign recognition. The proposed framework departs from the conventional globally shared parameter paradigm by introducing a heterogeneous You Only Look Once (YOLO) expert pool together with a lightweight gating network, enabling an image-level dynamic routing mechanism. Based on the semantic characteristics of the input image, the gating module selectively activates the most suitable expert model from the expert pool, enabling a shift from fixed parameter fitting to on-demand dynamic representation. This design enhances feature extraction capability for specific scenarios while maintaining controlled inference overhead. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a remarkable balance between detection accuracy and efficiency on the composite traffic sign dataset. Specifically, our method attains an mAP50-95 of 76.8%, yielding a 2.3% improvement over the baseline method (74.5%) while simultaneously reducing computational overhead by approximately 39.4%. These findings robustly validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [209] [ROGLE: Robust Global-Local Alignment with Automated Region Supervision for Text-Based Person Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01825)
*Zequn Xie,Xibei Jia,Sihang Cai,Shulei Wang,Tao Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ROGLE框架，通过自动化的区域-句子匹配策略和多粒度学习，解决CLIP-based文本行人检索模型在细粒度理解上的不足；同时构建了首个支持全局和局部评估的P-VLG基准数据集，实验表明ROGLE显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TBPS模型（尤其是基于CLIP的）因全局表征偏置和语义稀疏性（源于短标题训练），在细粒度对齐上表现不佳，且缺乏区域级标注数据。

Method: 提出ROGLE框架，包含：(1) 自动区域-句子匹配策略，挖掘伪区域-句子对实现细粒度监督；(2) 多粒度学习策略，融合全局对比学习与区域级局部对齐；(3) 构建P-VLG基准，含10万+标注区域和长描述文本。

Result: ROGLE在多个基准上显著优于现有方法，尤其在长查询任务上表现突出。

Conclusion: 自动化区域级伪标注结合多粒度学习能有效提升TBPS的细粒度对齐能力，P-VLG基准可推动全局与局部评估的标准化。

Abstract: Text-Based Person Search (TBPS) aims to retrieve pedestrian images using natural language queries. However, existing TBPS models, especially those based on CLIP, struggle with fine-grained understanding due to global representational bias and semantic sparsity inherited from training on short captions. This results in weak fine-grained alignment, exacerbated by the scarcity of region-level annotations. To address this, we propose ROGLE (Robust Global-Local Embedding), a unified framework that overcomes reliance on costly manual annotations through an automated Region-to-Sentence Matching (RSM) strategy. RSM automatically mines pseudo region-sentence pairs for scalable fine-grained supervision. Furthermore, ROGLE employs a multi-granular learning strategy that fuses global contrastive learning with region-level local alignment. We also introduce the P-VLG Benchmark, a large-scale dataset constructed by curating and enriching images from established public benchmarks. It features over 100,000 annotated regions and rich long-form captions, making it the first TBPS benchmark to support both global and local assessment protocols. Extensive experiments show that ROGLE significantly outperforms existing approaches, particularly on challenging long-form queries. Code and the P-VLG benchmark will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [210] [Physics-Guided Attention in a Lightweight TCN for Efficient WiFi CSI-Based Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01834)
*Chinthaka Ranasingha,Tharindu Fernando,Sridha Sridharan,Clinton Fookes,Harshala Gammulle*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于紧凑时间卷积网络（TCN）的WiFi CSI人体动作识别框架，通过显式引入运动感知的归纳偏置（多普勒能量引导的时间注意力机制和方差驱动的通道注意力模块），在不增加网络深度的情况下高效捕获运动动态，在多个基准数据集上以更少参数和计算开销超越深层基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的WiFi CSI人体动作识别方法依赖深度且计算密集的架构来隐式捕获运动动态，导致模型复杂度高、效率低下。本文旨在通过引入适配CSI信号物理特性的归纳偏置，实现更高效、有效的学习。

Method: 提出一种紧凑的TCN框架，显式融入运动感知归纳偏置：(1) 多普勒能量引导的时间注意力机制，在特征空间中强调运动显著的时间段；(2) 方差驱动的通道注意力模块，基于时间运动统计量自适应加权信息子载波。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，所提方法以显著更少的参数和计算成本，实现了优于更深层基线模型的性能。

Conclusion: 通过将领域特定的物理先验（归纳偏置）集成到特征学习中，紧凑型模型能够有效捕获运动动态，无需依赖深层架构，为高效CSI-based HAR提供了新范式。

Abstract: Human Action Recognition (HAR) using WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) has gained increasing attention due to its non-contact, low-cost, and privacy-preserving nature. However, existing learning-based approaches largely rely on deep, computationally intensive architectures to implicitly capture motion dynamics from CSI measurements, thereby increasing model complexity and reducing efficiency. Instead, we argue that incorporating appropriate inductive biases tailored to the physical characteristics of CSI signals enables more efficient and effective learning. In this work, we propose a compact temporal convolutional network (TCN)-based framework that explicitly incorporates motion-aware inductive biases into feature learning. Specifically, we introduce a Doppler-energy-guided temporal attention mechanism in feature space to emphasize motion-salient time segments, and a variance-driven channel attention module to weight informative subcarriers based on temporal motion statistics adaptively. By integrating these domain-specific priors, the proposed model effectively captures motion dynamics without increasing architectural depth. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance compared to deeper baselines, while significantly reducing parameter count and computational cost.

</details>


### [211] [Suppressing Forgery-Specific Shortcuts for Generalizable Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01843)
*Yihui Wang,Yonghui Yang,Jilong Liu,Fengbin Zhu,Le Wu,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Shortcut Subspace Suppression (S^3)框架，通过子空间建模显式地表征和抑制特定于伪造方法的捷径，从而提升深度伪造检测的跨方法泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测方法泛化能力差，模型倾向于依赖特定于伪造方法的虚假捷径，这些捷径无法迁移到未见过的伪造操作上，且缺乏显式的机制来识别和抑制这些捷径。

Method: (1) 训练轻量线性探针对伪造方法进行分类，通过SVD提取主导捷径子空间；(2) 训练阶段：在特征表示中软抑制捷径子空间，迫使模型依赖更通用的线索；(3) 推理阶段：无训练地衰减与捷径方向对齐的神经元，实现即插即用的泛化增强。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法显著提升了跨方法泛化性能，同时保持了较强的域内检测能力。

Conclusion: S^3框架通过显式建模和抑制方法特定捷径，有效提升了深度伪造检测的跨方法泛化能力，且推理阶段的无训练变体具有良好的可解释性和即插即用特性。

Abstract: Deepfake detection suffers from poor generalization across forgery methods, as existing models tend to rely on spurious method-specific shortcuts that fail to transfer to unseen manipulations. While recent approaches attempt to improve generalization, they lack an explicit mechanism to identify and suppress such shortcuts in learned representations. In this work, we propose Shortcut Subspace Suppression (S^3) framework that explicitly characterizes and suppresses method-specific shortcuts via subspace modeling. Our key insight is that variations distinguishing different forgery methods capture method-specific artifacts and thus serve as an effective proxy for method-specific shortcuts. To this end, we train a lightweight linear probe for forgery method classification and perform Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to extract the dominant shortcut subspace. Building on this formulation, we develop two complementary strategies to reduce shortcut reliance. During training, we softly suppress the shortcut subspace in feature representations, encouraging the model to rely on more generalizable cues for real/fake discrimination. At inference time, we introduce a training-free counterpart that attenuates neurons aligned with the identified shortcut directions, enabling plug-and-play generalization enhancement with improved interpretability. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly improves cross-method generalization while maintaining strong in-domain performance. The code will be released upon acceptance of the submission.

</details>


### [212] [RescueBench: Can Embodied Agents Save Lives in the Wild ?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01848)
*Kui Wu,Beiyu Guo,Hao Chen,ShuHang Xu,Yuling Li,Yongdan Zeng,Zhoujun Li,Yizhou Wang,Fangwei Zhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RescueBench是一个面向搜救任务的四阶段具身智能诊断基准，包含渐进难度、自动生成管线，实验发现自主探索是主要失败模式，空间记忆是次要瓶颈，现有方法无法完成最高难度任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准孤立评估探索、交互、记忆等能力，未考虑这些能力在真实搜救工作流中组合时失败如何累积传播。

Method: 将搜救任务分解为多模态探索、目标救援、记忆引导返回、最终移交四阶段流水线，设计五个渐进难度等级，构建自动化的情节生成与标注管线。

Result: 七种基线方法均无法在最高难度下完成任务；阶段级诊断表明自主探索是主要失败模式，空间记忆是第二个独立瓶颈。

Conclusion: 当前基于拓扑视觉语言导航或地图的方法尚无法解决搜救任务中的探索与记忆组合瓶颈，RescueBench为系统性诊断具身任务失败传播提供了有效工具。

Abstract: Search-and-rescue (SAR) requires embodied agents to explore unfamiliar environments under multimodal uncertainty, perform multi-stage interactions, and retrieve spatial memory over long horizons. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these capabilities in isolation, leaving unclear how failures compound when they must be composed in realistic workflows. We introduce RescueBench, a photo-realistic diagnostic benchmark that instantiates SAR as a four-stage pipeline: multimodal exploration, target rescue, memory-guided return, and final handoff. By combining sequential task composition with stage-level evaluation, RescueBench enables analysis of how exploration and memory failures propagate through embodied rescue workflows. It contains five progressive difficulty levels that vary in environmental complexity, clue ambiguity, and spatial hierarchy, along with an automatic episode generation and annotation pipeline for scalable evaluation and training. We evaluate seven baselines, an oracle reference, and human players, showing that no baselines complete the full task at the greatest difficulty. Stage-level diagnosis identifies autonomous exploration as the dominant failure mode and spatial memory as a second, independent bottleneck, suggesting that these limitations are not resolved by current topological visual-language navigation or map-based methods. Code is available in https://github.com/wukui-muc/RescueBench

</details>


### [213] [Polaris: Scaling Up Instruction-Guided Image Generation Towards Millions of Personalized Style Needs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01858)
*Zhi-Kai Chen,Jun-Peng Jiang,Jun-Jie Tao,De-Chuan Zhan,Han-Jia Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Polaris是一个智能检索框架，通过从超过6,500个检查点和75,000个适配器的模型库中自动检索和整合最相关的预训练模块，实现无需额外训练的可扩展、可控且对齐良好的图像生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像生成模型依赖微调来适应个性化需求，但微调成本高、难以扩展。社区积累了大量微调模块和适配器，但缺乏系统性利用这些现有资源的方法，因此需要一种能够自动从模型库中选择和整合合适模块的框架。

Method: Polaris构建了一个包含6,500多个检查点和75,000多个适配器的索引库，根据用户指令自动检索最相关的组件，并将它们有效地对齐整合，用于指令驱动的图像生成和编辑，整个过程无需额外训练。

Result: Polaris能够从海量异构模型池中精准找到最相关的模块，并实现可扩展、可控且对齐良好的图像生成，无需任何额外的训练成本。

Conclusion: 系统性利用已有的模型生态系统能够有效替代重复训练新模型的做法，Polaris证明了通过智能检索和整合现有模块可以实现更好的用户指令满足度，为个性化图像生成提供了可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Users increasingly expect image generation models to quickly adapt to highly diverse and personalized requirements, such as producing images with distinctive styles or characteristics. Traditional approaches rely on fine-tuning, which is costly and difficult to scale. To cope with these limitations, the community has accumulated a growing library of fine-tuned modules and adapters, where each component targets specific generation needs and collectively serves as a foundation for handling new demands. This naturally raises a question: instead of repeatedly training new models, can we systematically exploit this expanding ecosystem to better fulfill user instructions? To this end, we present Polaris, an intelligent retrieval framework that automatically selects and integrates suitable models from the model library based on a user's instructions. The key insight is that harnessing such a massive and heterogeneous pool requires not only finding the most relevant modules among thousands of candidates, but also aligning them effectively for instruction-driven generation and editing. Polaris addresses this challenge by indexing over 6,500 checkpoints and 75,000 adapters, and retrieving the most relevant components given a user's input and instruction. In doing so, it delivers scalable, controllable, and well-aligned generation -- without any additional training.

</details>


### [214] [Deep Learning for Generating Computational PIN-4 Immunohistochemistry Staining from Prostate Biopsy H&E Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01871)
*Vietbao Tran,Pratik Shah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了配准的H&E/PIN-4前列腺活检数据集，并训练条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）直接从H&E图像合成PIN-4免疫组化染色模式，在保留空间对应关系的前提下，实现了对诊断相关PIN-4标记模式的准确生成，解决了传统相邻切片IHC空间对比受限的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统PIN-4免疫组化染色通常在H&E染色的相邻组织切片上进行，限制了H&E形态与免疫表型信号之间的直接空间对比。本文旨在解决这一空间局限性，通过深度学习直接从H&E图像合成PIN-4染色模式，实现源H&E形态背景下对预测标记模式的直接解释。

Method: 构建了配准的H&E/PIN-4前列腺活检WSI数据集（来自93名患者的172对WSI，共27,298对1024×1024配准图块），训练cGAN从H&E图像块合成PIN-4染色模式，并在包含1,814对图块的独立测试集上评估。

Result: 测试集上PSNR为21.88 dB，SSIM为0.667，PCC为0.684，LPIPS为0.417；病理学家定性评估显示生成图像捕获了诊断相关的PIN-4染色模式（AMACR/racemase表达和基底细胞相关染色），并保持了与源H&E形态的空间对应关系；但在高级别癌和导管内癌等形态复杂区域合成准确性存在差异。

Conclusion: 结果表明，从常规亮场H&E前列腺活检图像进行监督式PIN-4合成是可行的，该方法克服了传统相邻切片IHC的空间局限性，可在源H&E组织学架构背景下直接解释预测的PIN-4标记模式。

Abstract: Immunohistochemistry (IHC)is frequently used to resolve diagnostically ambiguous prostate cancer biopsy findings on hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained tissue. However, PIN-4 IHC staining is typically performed on adjacent tissue sections, limiting direct spatial comparison between the H&E morphology and the corresponding immunophenotypic signal. A paired, registered H&E/PIN-4 dataset was constructed from routine clinical prostate biopsy whole-slide images (WSIs), and a conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN) was trained to synthesize PIN-4 staining patterns directly from native H&E image patches. The final dataset comprised 172 paired WSIs from 93 patients and 27,298 registered 1024x1024 patch pairs, spanning adenocarcinoma-positive and benign cases with representation across age, race, and ethnicity groups. The model was evaluated on a held-out test set of 1,814 patch pairs from 17 WSIs, achieving a mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 21.88 dB, structural similarity index measure (SSIM) of 0.667, Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) of 0.684, and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) of 0.417. Qualitative review by a board-certified pathologist showed that generated images captured diagnostically relevant PIN-4 staining patterns, including AMACR/racemase expression and basal-cell-associated staining, while preserving spatial correspondence with the source H&E morphology. Accuracy of synthesis varied across morphologically complex regions, including high-grade carcinoma and intraductal carcinoma. These results support the feasibility of supervised PIN-4 synthesis from routinely acquired brightfield H&E prostate biopsy images. The approach enables direct interpretation of predicted PIN-4 marker patterns in the context of the source prostate H&E architecture, addressing a current spatial limitation of conventional adjacent-section IHC.

</details>


### [215] [Divide and Conquer: Reliable Multi-View Evidential Learning for Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01885)
*Xiaolu Kang,Zhongyuan Wang,Jikang Cheng,Baojin Huang,Zhanhe Lei,Gang Wu,Qin Zou,Qian Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DiCoME框架，通过“分而治之”策略解决深度伪造检测中语义掩盖效应：先利用几何视角净化分解纠缠的表征空间，再通过不确定性感知的认知学习融合语义与伪影线索，实现泛化性能与可靠不确定性估计的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单视角深度伪造检测方法因语义特征主导而掩盖细微伪影线索（语义掩盖效应），导致过度自信但脆弱的预测，难以泛化到未知伪造类型。

Method: Divide阶段：几何视角净化（Geometric View Purification），通过几何投影分解纠缠表征空间，抑制语义干扰，形成解耦且互补的语义视图与伪影视图。Conquer阶段：不确定性感知认知学习（Uncertainty-Aware Evidential Learning），显式建模语义与伪影线索之间的“认知冲突”，提供校准的不确定性估计。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，DiCoME在泛化性能上一致优于现有方法，同时提供可靠的不确定性估计。

Conclusion: DiCoME通过解耦语义与伪影视角并融合认知不确定性，有效缓解语义掩盖效应，为可信深度伪造检测提供了新范式。

Abstract: With the evolution of generative models, deepfakes have achieved near-perfect semantic realism, leaving forensic traces only in subtle structural anomalies. However, existing single-view paradigms often fail to generalize, as dominant semantic features overwhelm subtle artifact cues within entangled representations. This imbalance leads to overconfident yet brittle predictions -- a phenomenon we term the Semantic Masking Effect. To address this challenge, we propose a reliable framework called Divide-and-Conquer Multi-View Evidential Learning (DiCoME) for Deepfake Detection. In the "Divide" phase, we employ Geometric View Purification to decompose the entangled representation space through principled geometric projection. This process suppresses semantic interference within artifact-sensitive representations, forming the foundation for decorrelated yet complementary semantic and artifact views. In the "Conquer" phase, we leverage Uncertainty-Aware Evidential Learning to synthesize these distinct views. By explicitly modeling the "epistemic conflict" between semantic and artifact cues, this mechanism provides calibrated uncertainty estimates instead of forcing rigid deterministic decisions. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing approaches in generalization performance, while providing reliable uncertainty estimation for trustworthy deepfake detection. Code is available at https://github.com/kxl0825/DiCoME.git.

</details>


### [216] [Adversarial Attacks on Robot Localization Systems via Deep Feature Perturbation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01892)
*Zhenyu Li,Tianyi Shang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对基于产品量化（PQ）的视觉定位系统的对抗攻击框架LPQN，通过轻量级网络生成对抗查询，误导检索过程，暴露了深度学习定位管线的重大安全漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人定位系统对自主导航和安全至关重要，而对抗扰动可能误导定位系统导致严重事故。现有研究对基于深度学习的视觉定位系统（尤其是使用PQ的管线）的对抗攻击脆弱性缺乏充分探索。

Method: 提出LPQN（轻量级产品量化网络），通过两阶段过程生成对抗查询：前向传播扰动特征分布，反向传播通过优化精炼扰动。其轻量设计使得扰动细微高效且计算开销极小。

Result: 在受控环境和真实机器人场景中的大量实验表明，该方法显著降低了PQN的性能，暴露了实际应用中的关键漏洞。

Conclusion: 基于PQ的视觉定位系统存在严重安全脆弱性，LPQN成功揭示了深度学习定位管线在面对对抗攻击时的不足，对机器人安全具有重要警示意义。

Abstract: Robot localization systems are critical for autonomous navigation and safety. Adversarial perturbations can mislead these systems, resulting in mislocalization, navigation errors, or unsafe interactions, especially in mission-critical scenarios. This paper investigates the vulnerability of deep learning based localization pipelines to adversarial attacks. We propose a novel framework for generating adversarial queries that specifically target Product Quantization (PQ) in visual localization systems. Our method employs a Lightweight Product Quantization Network (LPQN) to perturb query feature encodings, misleading the retrieval process by returning semantically irrelevant database entries. Adversarial queries are generated via a two-phase procedure: a forward pass that perturbs feature distributions and a backward pass that refines the perturbation through optimization. The lightweight design of LPQN allows the creation of subtle yet highly effective perturbations with minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments in both controlled and real-world robotic environments demonstrate that our approach substantially degrades PQN performance, exposing critical vulnerabilities in practical applications.

</details>


### [217] [Collaborative Space Object Detection with Multi-Satellite Viewpoints in LEO Constellations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01895)
*Xingyu Qu,Wenxuan Zhang,Peng Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于深度学习框架的多视点观测融合方法，用于提升低地球轨道星座中空间目标检测的性能。实验表明，多视点融合（尤其是三视图灰度融合）相比单视图显著提升了mAP50和mAP50-95指标，验证了该策略在空间态势感知中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着低地球轨道卫星数量激增，近地空间环境日益拥挤，空间目标检测面临严峻挑战。为了在严格的星载约束下实现快速准确的检测以降低碰撞风险，需要探索更有效的检测方法。

Method: 设计了多视点观测融合的实用流水线及多种输入表示方法，将多视点数据输入YOLO系列检测器中进行训练和评估，对比单视图与多视图（如三视图RGB、三视图灰度等）的检测性能。

Result: 多视点融合在大多数情况下可行且效果更优。以YOLOv9-m为例，三视图RGB融合相比单视图，mAP50从0.638提升至0.732，mAP50-95从0.227提升至0.276。最佳三视图灰度配置相比单视图，mAP50提升36.3%，mAP50-95提升46.5%。

Conclusion: 多视点融合是一种可行且有效的空间目标检测策略，对低轨星座部署中的空间态势感知具有广泛的应用意义。

Abstract: With the growing number of satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) constellations, the near-Earth space environment has become increasingly congested, making space object detection (SOD) a pressing challenge for space safety and sustainability. To mitigate collision risks and ensure the continuity of space operations, SOD systems must deliver fast and accurate detection under stringent onboard constraints. In this paper, we investigate the potential of multi-viewpoint observation fusion within a deep learning (DL) framework to enhance SOD performance. We design a practical multi-view pipeline and several input representations for feeding multi-view data into YOLO-based detectors. Our experiments show that using multi-view inputs is feasible in most cases and typically produces better results for mAP50 and mAP50-95. For example, in model YOLOv9-m, single-view compared to a three-view fused RGB setting, mAP50 increases from 0.638 to 0.732, while mAP50-95 improves from 0.227 to 0.276. Compared with the single-view setting, the best three-view grayscale configuration improves mAP50 by 36.3% and mAP50-95 by 46.5%. These findings establish multi-view fusion as a viable and effective strategy for SOD, with broad implications for space situational awareness in LEO constellation deployments.

</details>


### [218] [Train, Test, Re-evaluate: Schedule-Sensitive Evaluation of Generative Data for Hand Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01896)
*Atmika Bhardwaj,Silvia Vock,Nico Steckhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究使用生成式图像修复（inpainting）在手部区域添加手套、纹身等配饰，生成合成数据来弥补真实手部检测数据集中手部外观多样性不足的问题。实验表明，通过多阶段训练策略（先预训练再微调），合成数据能显著提升YOLOv8n在真实场景中的检测性能（mAP@0.5），并缩小带手套等分布外样本的性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实手部检测数据集（尤其是职业安全场景）中多数为裸手，对手套、纹身、珠宝等配饰覆盖不足，导致部署时出现分布偏移。作者希望验证生成式inpainting是否能够通过编辑照片手部区域添加配饰来缩小这一分布差距。

Method: 使用生成式图像修复编辑真实照片的手部区域以引入配饰，构建成对的真实与合成数据集。基于YOLOv8n训练手部检测器，设计六种训练与调度策略（实验A-F，各3个随机种子），在真实测试集和仅含手套的真实子集上评估，报告mAP@0.5和mAP@0.5:0.95，并进行配对统计检验。

Result: 两阶段实验（真实+合成数据预训练 → 低学习率真实数据微调）在标准真实测试集上相比纯真实基线提升了mAP@0.5，并缩小了真实手套分布外性能差距。三阶段实验在mAP@0.5:0.95上达到所有实验中的最高值，保持了最优的边界框紧致度。

Conclusion: 合成数据对安全关键手部检测的效用取决于训练流程设计，简单的多阶段实验能够从inpainted配饰数据中提取出显著的真实部署收益。

Abstract: Generated (or synthetic) image data is increasingly used to augment or replace real training datasets when target imagery is scarce, expensive, or biased. For hand detection, particularly in occupational safety settings, public datasets mostly contain bare hands. This under-represents the variation in hand appearance introduced by gloves, tattoos, jewelry, and other personal protective equipment, creating a distribution shift that safety-critical applications encounter at deployment. We test whether generative inpainting, editing only the hand region of a real photograph to introduce accessories, can close this shift gap. On a paired dataset of real images and their synthetic counterparts, we train YOLOv8n hand detectors under six training-and-scheduling regimes (Experiments A-F, three random seeds each), evaluate every detector on a real test set and on a real-gloves-only test split, and report the mean average precision (mAP) at two overlap thresholds (mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95) along with paired statistical tests. A two-stage experiment: train on real U synthetic data, then fine-tune the resulting weights on real-only at a lower learning rate, increases mAP@0.5 compared to the real-only baseline model on the standard real test set, and improves the real-gloves out-of-distribution gap. Another three-stage experiment preserves box-tightness best, reaching the highest mAP@0.5:0.95 of any other experiment in the study. The synthetic-data utility for safety-critical hand detection is determined by the training procedure, and simple multi-stage experiments extract substantial real-deployment benefit from inpainted accessory data.

</details>


### [219] [Auteur: Language-Driven Cinematographic Framing for Human-Centric Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01900)
*Muhammed Burak Kizil,Enes Sanli,Niloy J. Mitra,Xuelin Chen,Erkut Erdem,Aykut Erdem,Duygu Ceylan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Auteur方法，通过以人为中心的相机参数化、领域特定语言(DSL)和多模态大语言模型，实现了语言驱动的、以人为中心的生成视频相机控制，在34K对齐数据集上训练，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成视频模型虽在视觉保真度和时间连贯性上取得显著进展，但有意地控制相机运动仍难以实现。现有框架将相机运动视为像素合成的副产品，产生的轨迹具有随机性、空间不一致性，且对驱动场景的人类主体不敏感。专业电影摄影师并非将镜头视为世界空间轨迹，而是定义为相对于演员的取景，编码镜头尺寸、角度和构图作为人体姿态和运动的函数，现有模型缺乏这种以人为中心的相机控制能力。

Method: 1) 提出以人为中心的相机参数化方法，将相机运动表示为相对于人体姿态和运动的函数；2) 设计可转换至标准6自由度相机参数的领域特定语言(DSL)；3) 微调多模态大语言模型作为虚拟导演，将自然语言描述和粗略人体运动映射为稀疏DSL关键帧，再确定性地插值为连续相机轨迹；4) 构建34K对齐的文本、人体运动和DSL标注相机轨迹数据集，包含程序化合成和CondensedMovies数据集中的真实电影镜头。

Result: 在34K对齐数据集上训练和评估，提出新的取景导向评估指标，实验表明Auteur在电影化取景能力上持续优于现有方法，实现了先前生成模型普遍缺乏的以人为中心的电影化取景能力。

Conclusion: Auteur通过以人为中心的相机参数化和DSL设计，结合多模态大语言模型作为虚拟导演，成功实现了语言驱动的、以人为中心的生成视频相机控制，填补了现有生成模型在电影化取景方面的空白。

Abstract: Generative video models have achieved remarkable visual fidelity and temporal coherence, yet intentional camera control remains elusive. Existing frameworks treat camera motion as a byproduct of pixel synthesis, producing trajectories that are stochastic, spatially inconsistent, and indifferent to the human subject driving the scene. In this work, we present Auteur, a method for language-driven, human-centric camera framing in generative video. Our core insight is that professional filmmakers conceive shots not as world-space trajectories but as framings defined relative to the actor, encoding shot size, angle, and composition as functions of human pose and motion. We formalize this intuition as a human-centric camera parameterization and introduce a Domain-Specific Language (DSL) that is convertible to standard 6-DoF camera parameters. A fine-tuned multimodal large language model then acts as a virtual director, mapping natural language descriptions and coarse human motion to sparse DSL keyframes that are deterministically interpolated into continuous camera trajectories, which are then provided as input to video generators. We train and evaluate Auteur on a new dataset of 34K aligned text, human motion, and DSL-annotated camera trajectories drawn from procedural synthesis and real-world movie footage from the CondensedMovies dataset. Auteur enables cinematographic framing of human-centered scenes, a capability largely absent in prior generative models. To assess this behavior, we propose new framing-focused metrics, and our experiments show that Auteur consistently outperforms existing methods

</details>


### [220] [Residual Decoder Adapter: ID-Preserving Tokenizer Adaption for Autoregressive Text Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01911)
*Dongxing Mao,Jinpeng Wang,Jiahao Tang,Kevin Qinghong Lin,Linjie Li,Zhengyuan Yang,Lijuan Wang,Min Li,Jingru Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出残差解码器适配器(RDA)，在不重新训练视觉分词器和自回归模型的前提下，通过配对码本和并行分支学习像素空间残差，显著提升文本渲染效果，OCR准确率从24.52%提升至58.26%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉自回归模型在文本渲染方面表现不佳，存在笔画模糊、字母形状变形等问题，根本原因在于视觉分词器难以重建细粒度细节。重新训练分词器和AR模型成本高昂，因此需要一种无需重新训练即可提升文本渲染性能的方法。

Method: 提出残差解码器适配器(RDA)，对已有视觉分词器进行事后升级：(i) 配对码本，与原码本共享token分布；(ii) 并行分支，学习重建图像与真实图像在像素空间的微小差异（残差）。这种残差设计无需改变token空间，非侵入式地增强分词器。

Result: 在TextAtlas基准上，微调后的Janus-Pro OCR准确率从24.52%提升至58.26%（TextVisionBlend），从12.75%提升至36.81%（StyledTextSynth）。

Conclusion: RDA能够在不重新训练现有分词器和AR模型的前提下，大幅提升文本渲染性能，保持与原有AR模型的兼容性。

Abstract: Visual Autoregressive (AR) models generate images by predicting discrete tokens that are decoded by a visual tokenizer. Despite demonstrating strong overall image generation ability, they still underperform on text rendering with blur strokes and disrupt letter shapes. In this work, we trace this limitation to the visual tokenizer, which struggles to reconstruct fine-grained detail. Improving the tokenizer is straightforward but expensive, as it necessitates retraining both the tokenizer and the AR model. Can we improve text rendering performance of AR models without retraining the existing tokenizer and AR model? To achieve this, we propose the Residual Decoder Adapter(RDA) that upgrades an existing tokenizer post-hoc without changing its token space. Specifically, it refines the decoder output of the visual tokenizer by introducing two novel components: (i) a paired codebook that shares the token distribution with the original one; (ii) a parallel branch to learn the tiny differences (residual) between the reconstructed image and the ground-truth images in the pixel space. This residual design allows us to enhance the tokenizer non-invasively while preserving compatibility with prior AR models. RDA substantially improves text rendering significantly by a large margin. For instance, we boost finetuned Janus-Pro OCR accuracy rises from 24.52% to 58.26% (TextVisionBlend), from 12.75% to 36.81% (StyledTextSynth) on competitive TextAtlas benchmark. The code is available at https://github.com/CSU-JPG/RDA

</details>


### [221] [Pool-Select-Refine: Allocation-Aware Generative Dataset Distillation with Soft-Label-Guided Latent Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01920)
*Wenmin Li,Shunsuke Sakai,Zhongkai Zhao,Tatsuhito Hasegawa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"Pool-Select-Refine"两阶段框架，通过构建过完备候选池、子集选择及潜在空间精炼，解耦生成-选择-精炼过程，实现预算感知的生成式数据集蒸馏，在大型和细粒度图像分类基准上优于现有扩散基方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散基数据集蒸馏方法采用僵硬的"生成即用"策略，候选生成与预算分配紧密耦合，导致有限预算浪费或样本信息不足。

Method: 1) 构建过完备候选池并选择紧凑子集；2) 在潜在空间中利用教师模型的软标签监督精炼所选样本，提升语义对齐同时保持生成先验。

Result: 在大型和细粒度图像分类基准上，该方法一致优于扩散基基线，表明在精炼前引入筛选阶段是提升扩散基数据集蒸馏的简单有效方式。

Conclusion: 解耦生成、选择与精炼的设计能更有效地利用蒸馏预算，筛选阶段的引入是改进扩散基数据集蒸馏的关键。

Abstract: Diffusion-based dataset distillation has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for condensing large-scale datasets into compact synthetic sets. By leveraging pretrained generative priors, these methods can produce realistic class-conditional samples more efficiently than traditional matching-based approaches. However, most existing diffusion-based methods still adopt a rigid ``Generate-and-Use'' strategy, where the generated samples are directly treated as the final distilled set under a fixed images-per-class budget. Such a design tightly couples candidate generation with final budget allocation, which may result in redundant waste of the limited budget or insufficiently informative samples. In this paper, we propose ``Pool-Select-Refine'', a two-stage framework for allocation-aware generative dataset distillation. First, instead of directly using a fixed number of generated samples, we construct an over-complete candidate pool and select a compact subset under the target budget. Second, we refine the selected samples in latent space using soft-label supervision derived from the teacher model, improving semantic alignment while preserving the generative prior. This design explicitly decouples generation, selection, and refinement, enabling more effective use of the distillation budget. Experiments on large-scale and fine-grained image classification benchmarks show that the proposed framework delivers consistent gains over diffusion-based baselines. The results suggest that introducing a curation stage before refinement is a simple yet effective way to improve diffusion-based dataset distillation.

</details>


### [222] [3rd Place at CVPR 2026 CASTLE Challenge: Agentic Multi-View Long-Context Video Understanding via Hierarchical Knowledge Graph Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01933)
*Raghad Albusayes,Munirah Alyahya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个无训练代理框架，通过视频知识图谱和自适应代理工作流，在CVPR 2026 EgoVis Workshop的CASTLE 2026挑战赛中取得全球第三名，该框架能高效处理超600小时多视角视频流中的复杂视觉、时空和语言推理任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 应对CASTLE 2026挑战赛中大规模（超600小时、15个摄像头同步拍摄）、多模态视频流的极端长上下文需求，以及复杂的视觉计数、动作定位、多视角跟踪和说话者时序推理等任务，现有方法难以同时处理数据规模和推理复杂性。

Method: 提出无训练代理框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 视频知识图谱，建模静态和动态实体及其时序关系和相交事件，支持多跳关系推理；2) 自适应代理工作流，通过分层检索和索引机制解析复杂查询。

Result: 在CASTLE 2026挑战赛中获得全球第三名，框架在长上下文多视角视频流上实现了高零样本推理准确率。

Conclusion: 所提出的训练无关的代理框架能够有效应对大规模多视角视频理解中的长上下文和复杂推理挑战，无需额外训练即可实现优秀的零样本推理性能。

Abstract: This paper presents our winning methodology for the CASTLE 2026 Challenge at the CVPR 2026 EgoVis Workshop, where our team secured third place globally. The challenge tasks participants with answering highly complex visual, spatiotemporal, and verbal questions, including visual counting, action localization, multi-view tracking and speaker temporal reasoning, within massive, multimodal video streams. The underlying dataset consists of over 600 hours synchronized footage captured by 15 ego and exo camera sources. To tackle the extreme scale and long-context demands of this environment, we introduce a training-free agentic framework optimized for long-form video understanding. Our framework introduces two core architectural components: i) a Video Knowledge Graph that maps static and dynamic entities, their temporal relationships, and intersecting events to enable multi-hop relational reasoning, and ii) an adaptive agentic workflow that resolves complex queries through a hierarchical retrieval and indexing. Empirical results demonstrate that our framework achieves high zero-shot reasoning accuracy on long-context multi-view streams. Our code will be released at https://github.com/RaghadKhaled/CASTLE-Challenge-Framework.

</details>


### [223] [Unified Driving Tokens: Representation- and Geometry-Guided Discrete Tokenizer for Driving World Models and Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01935)
*Ziyang Yao,Zeyu Zhu,YunCheng Jiang,Zibin Guo,Huijing Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合表示引导与几何增强的离散视觉分词器，通过联合监督（特征解码、RGB重建、深度与相对位姿约束）优化自动驾驶中的离散token学习，在NAVSIM上提升了重建质量、表示一致性和规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离散视觉分词器大多继承自图像生成任务，仅以像素重建为优化目标，导致生成容易的token未必对驾驶决策有用，存在表征与决策之间的差距。

Method: 1) 在离散瓶颈层与冻结的DINO特征空间之间进行特征解码对齐；2) 通过RGB重建（感知损失+对抗损失）保留外观；3) 引入相邻帧深度与相对位姿监督注入几何状态信息；4) 使用多码本量化稳定联合目标优化。

Result: 在NAVSIM上：重建保真度和表示一致性提升；在固定解码器下规划性能有竞争力；在相同设置下生成质量更好。

Conclusion: 面向驾驶任务的离散token学习需要超越单纯的重建目标，结合语义特征对齐与几何约束能有效弥合生成与决策之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Discrete visual tokens should provide a compact representation for both token-based world modeling and planning in autonomous driving. However, most tokenizers are inherited from image generation and are optimized mainly for pixel reconstruction, which may leave a gap between what is easy to generate and what is useful to decode for driving decisions. We present a representation-guided and geometry-enhanced tokenizer that learns discrete tokens under joint supervision. The tokenizer aligns its discrete bottleneck with a frozen DINO feature space through feature decoding, while preserving appearance via RGB reconstruction with perceptual and adversarial losses. To inject geometric state-related cues, we add adjacent-frame depth and relative-pose supervision during training and stabilize joint objectives with multi-codebook quantization. We evaluate the same learned tokens with a lightweight planning readout and a GPT-style next-token world model. Experiments on NAVSIM show improved reconstruction fidelity and representation consistency, competitive planning performance under a fixed decoder, and better generative quality under matched settings.

</details>


### [224] [SAVMap: Structure-Aided Visual Mapping of Large-Scale 2.5D Manhattan Wireframes from Panoramic Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01939)
*Howard Huang,Bharath Surianarayanan,Keifer Lee,Chenyu Wang,Chen Feng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAVMap提出了一种仅利用全景视频相机生成仓库货架和灯光结构语义线框地图的方法，通过语义分割提取结构特征点并结合曼哈顿网格约束的运动恢复结构算法，在46排货架的仓库中实现了4.8cm的平均绝对误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业环境的精确3D表示对于机器人定位和数字孪生生成等任务至关重要，但现有方法在仓库等大规模结构化场景中面临着部署复杂性和精度不足的问题。本文旨在提出一种仅使用低成本全景相机即可高效生成语义线框地图的方法。

Method: 该方法首先从沿仓库通道采集的全景视频中提取面向货架和天花板的矫正图像序列；然后利用语义分割网络前端提取稀疏的语义结构特征点（如货架角点、灯具中心）；最后通过考虑曼哈顿网格等真实世界几何关系，采用约束运动恢复结构算法生成3D点以构成线框地图。

Result: 在包含46排货架（每排55m×7m）的仓库中，从1小时全景视频中为超过5000个货架元素生成了线框地图，相对于地面真值的累计平均绝对误差为4.8cm。

Conclusion: SAVMap证明了仅使用全景视频相机即可在大规模仓库环境中高效、准确地生成语义线框地图，具有良好的可扩展性和实用性，为工业场景下的自主定位和数字孪生提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Precise 3D representations of industrial environments enable tasks such as robot localization and digital twin generation. We propose SAVMap, a method for generating a semantic wireframe map of warehouse shelf and light structures using only a panoramic video camera as the sensor input. Sequences of rectified images with shelf and ceiling-facing views are extracted from a panoramic video captured along the warehouse aisles. Using a semantic segmentation network front end, a set of sparse, semantic structure feature points (e.g., corners of shelf structures, centers of lights) are extracted from each image and tracked across the sequences. By accounting for real-world geometric relationships among the points such as Manhattan grids, a constrained structure-from-motion algorithm yields the 3D points that form a wireframe map. We demonstrate the scalability and accuracy of our proposal in a warehouse with 46 shelving rows, each with faces spanning 55\,m by 7\,m. From an hour of panoramic video content, we create wireframe maps for over 5000 shelf elements across the rows, achieving an aggregate mean absolute error of 4.8\,cm with respect to ground-truth.

</details>


### [225] [SCAPO: Self-Supervised Category-Level Articulated Pose Estimation from a Single 3D Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01940)
*Can Zhang,Gim Hee Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SCAPO是一个自监督框架，无需真实标签或类别特定模型，即可从单张RGB-D观测中估计出规范几何、刚性部件分割、关节枢轴、轴线和关节状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖密集监督、多帧输入或CAD模板，难以从几何中解耦关节结构或恢复显式关节参数。

Method: 使用SE(3)-等变向量神经元自编码器消除全局姿态并对齐到共享规范空间；在该对齐形状上设计关节感知混合蒙皮模块建模部件运动；通过观测与规范形状间的循环重建以及跨空间对齐来学习表示，其中可学习规范模板解耦共享类别几何与实例特异性残差形状。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上恢复了一致的部件结构和准确的关节参数，优于所有自监督基线方法。

Conclusion: SCAPO有效实现了单视图、自监督的类别级物体关节估计，无需密集标注即可解耦几何与关节结构。

Abstract: Existing methods for category-level object articulation from a single 3D observation often rely on dense supervision, multi-frame inputs, or CAD templates, and still struggle to disentangle geometry from articulation or to recover explicit joint parameters. We propose SCAPO, a self-supervised framework that estimates canonical geometry, rigid part segmentation, and joint pivots, axes, and articulation states from a single RGB-D observation without ground-truth labels or category-specific models. Our SCAPO first uses an SE(3)-equivariant vector-neuron autoencoder to factor out global pose and align diverse instances into a shared canonical space. On this aligned shape, a joint-aware blend-skinning module is then designed to model part motion. We learn this representation through cycle reconstruction between observed and canonical shapes and cross-space alignment with a learnable canonical template that decouples shared category geometry from instance-specific residual shape. Experiments on synthetic and real articulated-object datasets show that our SCAPO recovers consistent part structure and accurate articulation parameters and outperforms all self-supervised baselines.

</details>


### [226] [Beyond Low-Rank: Low-Rank Sparse Prompting via Spiking Neural Network and Prompt Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01945)
*Yumiao Zhao,Bo Jiang,Beibei Wang,Xixi Wan,Xiao Wang,Jin Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LoRSP框架，通过融合脉冲神经元机制实现低秩稀疏视觉提示学习，在多个视觉骨干网络和基准上以更少可调参数取得竞争性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉提示方法采用密集像素级提示，存在冗余扰动、泛化能力有限和能效低的问题，亟需更紧凑高效的提示机制。

Method: 提出LoRSP框架：1）通过低秩分解构造提示因子捕捉不同提示子空间；2）将提示因子输入脉冲神经网络（SNN）进行整合-发放处理生成离散脉冲；3）产生实例级稀疏视觉提示，同时保持低秩约束。

Result: 在五种异构视觉骨干网络和多个基准上的实验表明，LoRSP在需更少可调参数的情况下取得了与现有视觉提示方法相当的竞争性能。

Conclusion: 受脑启发的脉冲学习机制能够有效解决密集提示的冗余和能效问题，低秩稀疏提示设计实现了更紧凑、鲁棒且实例自适应的视觉提示学习。

Abstract: Visual Prompting (VP) has emerged as an efficient paradigm for adapting large-scale pre-trained vision models to downstream tasks by incorporating learnable prompts at the input level. However, existing VP methods typically employ dense pixel-level prompts, which often suffer from redundant perturbations, limited generalization and energy inefficiency. To overcome these limitations, we propose to integrate brain-inspired spiking learning into visual prompt learning tasks. As we know that spiking neuron can perform inexpensive information processing by transmitting the input data into discrete spike trains and return sparse outputs. Inspired by this, we propose \textbf{Lo}w-\textbf{R}ank visual \textbf{S}pike \textbf{P}rompting (LoRSP), a novel framework that learns dynamic low-rank sparse visual prompts naturally via a Spiking neuron learning mechanism. The core idea of LoRSP is to exploit the brain-inspired sparse firing mechanism of spiking neurons to generate pixel-level sparse prompt for each instance. To be specific, we first construct a series of prompt factors via low-rank factorization to capture distinct prompt subspaces. These prompt factors are then fed into an SNN architecture, which performs the integrate-and-fire process to emit spikes. As a result, our LoRSP generates a \emph{sparse} visual prompt while maintaining the low-rank constraint. This design enables instance-specific selective prompting, leading to more compact and robust adaptation across diverse downstream tasks. Extensive experiments on five heterogeneous vision backbones and multiple benchmarks demonstrate that LoRSP achieves competitive performance while requiring fewer tunable parameters compared to existing VP methods.

</details>


### [227] [Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Pretrained Models for Instance Segmentation Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01947)
*Nermeen Abou Baker,David Rohrschneider,Uwe Handmann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究首次系统性地探索了参数高效微调（PEFT）方法（适配器和LoRA）在基于Transformer的实例分割模型中的应用，仅微调1-6%的参数即可达到与传统微调（40-55%参数）相当的性能，尤其发现将LoRA应用于可变形注意力机制以及每个Transformer块使用2-3个适配器可实现最优效率与性能平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对PEFT方法在Transformer-based实例分割模型中应用的系统性探索，尽管大模型参数激增亟需参数高效的训练策略。

Method: 在两种模型和四个基准数据集上，对适配器（顺序排列）和LoRA（首次应用于可变形注意力机制）两种PEFT方法进行实验对比。

Result: 仅微调1-6%参数即可达到竞争性能（传统方法需40-55%）；每Transformer块使用2-3个适配器实现最优平衡；LoRA应用于可变形注意力展现出强参数效率，某些情况下超越适配器配置。

Conclusion: PEFT方法的效果因数据集复杂度和模型架构而异，证明了上下文特异性调优的重要性；PEFT有潜力实现实例分割任务的可扩展、可定制且计算高效的迁移学习。

Abstract: Research and applications in artificial intelligence have recently shifted with the rise of large pretrained models, which deliver state-of-the-art results across numerous tasks. However, the substantial increase in parameters introduces a need for parameter-efficient training strategies. Despite significant advancements, limited research has explored parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods in the context of transformer-based models for instance segmentation. Addressing this gap, this study investigates the effectiveness of PEFT methods, specifically adapters and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), applied to two models across four benchmark datasets. Integrating sequentially arranged adapter modules and applying LoRA to deformable attention--explored here for the first time--achieves competitive performance while fine-tuning only about 1-6% of model parameters, a marked improvement over the 40-55% required in traditional fine-tuning. Key findings indicate that using 2-3 adapters per transformer block offers an optimal balance of performance and efficiency. Furthermore, LoRA, exhibits strong parameter efficiency when applied to deformable attention, and in certain cases surpasses adapter configurations. These results show that the impact of PEFT techniques varies based on dataset complexity and model architecture, underscoring the importance of context-specific tuning. Overall, this work demonstrates the potential of PEFT to enable scalable, customizable, and computationally efficient transfer learning for instance segmentation tasks.

</details>


### [228] [Contrastive Augmented Transformer with Domain-specific Enhancement for Robust Multi-scenario Metal Surface Defect Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01962)
*Yiyao Liua,Wenxiao He,Liyuan Ren,Huan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种对比增强Transformer（CAT）框架，用于金属表面缺陷检测。该框架采用层次化Swin Transformer骨干网络和重新设计的特征金字塔网络，结合域特定滴状增强算法和难负样本挖掘策略，在KolektorSDD2数据集上实现了99.54%的像素级AUROC，并在三个未见数据集上展现了优异的泛化性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金属表面缺陷检测在工业制造中面临三大挑战：标注数据有限、微小多尺度缺陷难以识别、跨场景泛化能力差。现有方法难以同时解决这些问题。

Method: 1) 采用层次化Swin Transformer作为骨干网络；2) 重新设计特征金字塔网络，融合低层纹理与高层语义；3) 提出域特定滴状增强算法（droplet augmentation）提升噪声鲁棒性；4) 在对比损失中引入难负样本挖掘策略，增强模糊缺陷区域的判别能力。

Result: 在KolektorSDD2数据集上达到像素级AUROC 99.54%，超越现有方法。在KSDD1、MTD（瓷砖缺陷）和MSDD（钢轨表面缺陷）三个未见数据集上表现出优越的泛化性和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: CAT框架有效解决了金属表面缺陷检测中的关键挑战，具备大规模工业部署的潜力。

Abstract: Metal surface defect detection is critical for maintaining product quality in industrial manufacturing. However, it faces significant challenges, including limited annotated data, difficulty in identifying subtle multi-scale defects, and poor generalization across diverse scenarios. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel Contrastive Augmented Transformer (CAT) framework for robust defect detection. CAT employs a hierarchical Swin Transformer backbone and redesigns the feature pyramid network to effectively fuse low-level textures with high-level semantics, enabling precise modeling of subtle and multi-scale defect patterns. To enhance robustness under real-world noise conditions, we propose a domain-specific droplet augmentation algorithm. Furthermore, we incorporate a hard negative mining strategy into the contrastive loss to strengthen the model's discrimination ability in ambiguous defect regions. Experimental results on the KolektorSDD2 dataset demonstrate that CAT achieves a pixel-level AUROC of 99.54%, outperforming existing methods. In addition, CAT exhibits superior generalization and robustness on three unseen datasets, including KSDD1, MTD for tile defects, and MSDD for rail surface defects, demonstrating its potential for wide-scale industrial deployment.

</details>


### [229] [Generalization Limits in Vehicle Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01981)
*Anis Yassine Ben Mabrouk,Antoine Tadros,Rafael Grompone von Gioi,Gabriele Facciolo,Axel Davy,Rodrigo Verschae*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出车辆重识别数据集存在训练集和测试集包含相同车型的问题，导致模型通过记忆训练数据获得高测试性能但泛化能力差。作者提出了一种新的评估方法来衡量对未见车型的泛化能力，并基于视角进行子集划分评估。实验表明大多数现有方法无法泛化到未见车型，且视角鲁棒性和细节关注能力仅限于训练中见过的车型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有车辆重识别数据集存在训练集和测试集包含相同外观相似车辆（相同品牌、型号、颜色）的问题，导致模型通过记忆训练数据获得高分，但泛化到其他数据集时表现不佳。

Method: 提出一种新的评估方法以更有效地衡量模型对未见车型的泛化能力；同时提出基于视角（view）的评估划分，以区分视角鲁棒性和相同视角重识别的影响。

Result: 大多数最先进方法在未见车型上泛化能力差；模型对视角变化的鲁棒性和细节关注度仅限于训练中见过的车型。

Conclusion: 现有车辆重识别方法存在严重的泛化问题，对未见车型和视角变化缺乏鲁棒性，需要更关注泛化能力的评估和提升。

Abstract: Vehicle re-identification focuses on retrieving images of the same vehicle from a gallery given a query image. Upon closer inspection of commonly used datasets, we observe that vehicles with few visual differences-e.g., the same make, model, and color-appear in both the training and test sets. As a result, methods that effectively memorize the training data tend to perform well on these test sets but struggle to generalize to other datasets. In this paper, we address this issue by proposing a novel evaluation approach that more effectively measures generalization capability to unseen vehicle types. To further study generalization performance, we also propose splitting the evaluation based on view, allowing us to differentiate the effect of viewpoint robustness from that of same-view re-identification. Our findings reveal that most state-of-the-art methods struggle with unseen vehicle types, and that their robustness to viewpoint changes and attention to detail are limited to vehicle types seen during training.

</details>


### [230] [MT-EditFlow: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Image Editing with Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01985)
*Jiahui Huang,Yasi Zhang,Tianyu Chen,Shu Wang,Jianwen Xie,Oscar Leong,Mingyuan Zhou,Nanzhu Wang,Ying Nian Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MT-EditFlow，一个基于流匹配强化学习的框架，通过多轮奖励优化解决指令式图像编辑在多轮交互中的错误传播和单轮失败导致的全序列崩溃问题，在FLUX.1-Kontext-dev上提升6.85分，超越Qwen-Image-Edit等开源模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的指令式图像编辑模型主要为单轮编辑训练，在多轮交互场景中表现不佳，原因在于：(1) 单轮失败导致整个编辑序列失败的"全有或全无"要求；(2) 暴露偏差导致的错误累积和传播。亟需一种能够从多轮视角优化编辑序列的方法。

Method: 提出MT-EditFlow框架，核心创新包括：(1) 多轮视角与多奖励公式的统一结构，可适用GRPO和基于NFT的强化学习方法；(2) 对奖励信号进行系统分析与优化，包括轮次级聚合的有效评分策略、平衡奖励偏差与方差的VLM推理模式、以及防止奖励黑客的advantage融合级别；(3) 将聚合的advantage广播到整个编辑轨迹，弥合局部规划与全局多轮任务成功之间的鸿沟。

Result: 在多种基础模型上显著提升性能，其中FLUX.1-Kontext-dev在第三轮整体性能提升6.85分，超越Qwen-Image-Edit等最先进的开源模型。保持了高边际成功率并减少了暴露偏差。

Conclusion: MT-EditFlow通过强化学习框架有效解决了多轮图像编辑中的错误传播问题，为视觉内容创作中更可靠、更自然的人机协作提供了基础。

Abstract: Recent breakthroughs in instruction-based image editing have captured significant attention, as models are now capable of handling real-world editing demands with the practicality required by everyday users. However, editing models trained primarily for single-turn edits often break down in multi-turn editing--the natural interactive setting where a user iteratively refines an image based on the model's own previous outputs. This failure stems from the all-or-nothing requirement, where a single failed turn compromises the entire sequence, and error propagation, where exposure bias leads to compounding editing errors. To address these challenges, we introduce MT-EditFlow, a flow-matching reinforcement learning framework designed to optimize reward signals for sequential image editing. MT-EditFlow integrates a multi-turn perspective with a multi-reward formulation to provide a unified structure applicable to both GRPO and NFT-based reinforcement learning methods. We systematically analyze and optimize the reward signal by investigating effective scoring strategies for turn-level aggregation, VLM reasoning modes to trade off reward bias and variance, and advantage fusion levels to prevent reward hacking. Our findings reveal that broadcasting the aggregated advantage across the entire editing trajectory effectively bridges the gap between local planning and global multi-turn task success. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MT-EditFlow significantly improves performance across diverse base models. Notably, it boosts FLUX.1-Kontext-dev by 6.85 points in turn-3 overall performance, surpassing state-of-the-art open-source models such as Qwen-Image-Edit. By maintaining high marginal success rates and reducing exposure bias, MT-EditFlow provides a foundation for more reliable and natural human-AI collaboration in visual content creation.

</details>


### [231] [A Structured Benchmark for Text-Guided Anomaly Detection: When Language Stops Conditioning the Decision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01992)
*Stefano Samele,Eugenio Lomurno,Teodora Jovanovic,Sanjay Shivakumar Manohar,Alberto Crivellaro,Matteo Matteucci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TGAD基准，系统评估多模态异常检测模型的语言引导能力。通过对三种代表性模型在三个递进场景中的测试发现，文本接口仅提供表面性条件控制：去除物体名词后生成模型性能大幅下降；组件级指令无法排除部件外缺陷；在真实工业场景APD上，图像级判别甚至低于随机水平。结论是现有基准夸大了多模态异常检测的语言引导能力，需要此类结构化协议来衡量模型是否真正可被语言可靠控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工业异常检测研究虽引入了多模态视觉-语言模型并声称支持文本引导的零样本和少样本检测，但评估协议继承自单模态基准，文本条件保持不变，无法衡量语言是否真正影响决策，报告的性能提升可能来自强预训练视觉特征而非文本引导。

Method: 构建TGAD基准，包含三个递进场景：(1) MVTec AD上的受控提示敏感性设置；(2) 组件级标注的MVTec AD扩展，要求模型将评估限制在指定部件；(3) 新提出的装配面板数据集APD，要求同时具备缺陷类型和组件位置知识。对三种范式（生成式大规模视觉-语言模型、免训练判别式、嵌入自适应判别式）各选一个代表模型进行评估。

Result: (1) 生成模型去除物体名词后I-AUROC从97.4降至82.6；(2) 组件级指令在引入部件外缺陷后从90.3降至66.3；(3) APD上图像级判别性能分别为71.2、50.5、31.5（低于随机水平）。三种模型的文本接口均仅提供表面性条件控制。

Conclusion: 标准基准高估了当前多模态异常检测系统的文本引导能力，此类结构化协议是衡量模型是否真正可通过语言可靠控制的必要条件，对工业部署至关重要。

Abstract: Industrial anomaly detection has historically been a unimodal task. Recent multimodal vision-language models have produced systems that admit textual input alongside the image and are presented as enabling text-guided zero- and few-shot inspection. Yet these methods are evaluated with protocols inherited from unimodal benchmarks that hold the textual condition constant and therefore cannot measure whether language conditions the decision; whether reported gains reflect text guidance or strong pretrained visual features remains open. We introduce Text-Guided Anomaly Detection (TGAD), a structured benchmark that progressively increases the functional role of language across three scenarios: a controlled prompt-sensitivity setting on MVTec AD; a component-tagged extension of MVTec AD that requires the model to restrict its assessment to an instructed part; and the new Assembled Panel Dataset (APD), a realistic industrial setting that requires both defect-type and component-location knowledge. We evaluate one representative model per paradigm: generative large vision-language, training-free discriminative, and embedding-adaptive discriminative. In all three, the textual interface conditions the decision only superficially: prompt content is absorbed unless the object noun is removed (the generative model's I-AUROC drops from 97.4 to 82.6); component-level instructions do not constrain the decision once defects outside the instructed part are admitted as normal (from 90.3 to 66.3); and when both combine on APD, image-level discrimination collapses below the MVTec level, in one case below chance (71.2, 50.5, 31.5). These results suggest that standard benchmarks overstate the text-guided capabilities of current multimodal anomaly detection systems, and that a protocol of this kind is a prerequisite for models that can be reliably controlled through language for industrial deployment.

</details>


### [232] [Towards 3D-Aware Video Diffusion Models: Render-Free Human Motion Control with Mesh Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02000)
*Jingyun Liang,Min Wei,Shikai Li,Yizeng Han,Hangjie Yuan,Lei Sun,Weihua Chen,Fan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于3D人体网格令牌化的无渲染视频生成框架，直接压缩3D人体网格为令牌，与视频令牌在DiT架构中联合处理，实现对3D人体结构、运动、视角和场景的精确建模，实验表明该方法优于依赖2D渲染引导的现有方法，并减少视角依赖伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究视频扩散模型是否真正理解视觉观察背后的3D结构，而不仅仅是生成合理的2D投影。现有方法依赖渲染的2D运动引导视频，存在视角依赖和轨迹-姿态不匹配等问题。

Method: 提出无渲染框架，将3D人体网格压缩为令牌表示，保留完整3D几何信息；采用DiT架构联合处理视频令牌和运动令牌，实现外观、3D结构和摄像头视角的联合推理。

Result: 在人体运动控制基准上表现优异，减少了由视角依赖的2D引导和轨迹-姿态不匹配引起的伪影。

Conclusion: 视频扩散模型配备网格令牌化后，能够更好地捕捉复杂3D人体结构及其与周围环境的交互。

Abstract: Diffusion models have shown remarkable success in video generation. However, whether such models are truly aware of the 3D structure underlying visual observations, rather than simply reproducing plausible 2D projections, remains an open question. In this work, we investigate this question through human motion control, a task that requires precise modelling of 3D human geometry, motion, camera viewpoint, and scene context. Unlike prior methods that rely on rendered 2D motion guidance videos, we propose a render-free framework that conditions video generation directly on compressed 3D human mesh tokens. This representation preserves full 3D geometric information while enabling a unified token-based generation pipeline that processes video tokens jointly with motion tokens in a DiT-based architecture. This design requires the model to reason jointly about appearance, 3D structure, and camera viewpoint during video generation. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance on human motion control benchmarks, while reducing artifacts induced by view-dependent 2D guidance and trajectory-pose mismatches during editing. These findings suggest that video diffusion models, when equipped with mesh tokenization, can better capture complex 3D human structures and their interactions with the surrounding environment.

</details>


### [233] [Distortion-Aware Fusion of Statistical and Vision-Language Features for Blind Image Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02002)
*Bishr Omer Abdelrahman Adam,Xu Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于乘性门控机制的失真感知融合框架，将138维NSS描述符与SigLIP、CLIP-H两种VLM嵌入动态融合，无需微调VLM骨干网络，在三个BIQA基准上达到SOTA性能，并通过门控值自动发现各特征流对失真类型的偏好模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NSS特征与VLM嵌入从完全不同的角度解决BIQA问题，但二者是否具有互补性以及如何根据输入图像自适应地分配二者的权重尚未被探索。

Method: 提出失真感知融合框架，通过乘性门控机制根据图像内容学习每个输入流的权重，动态抑制或放大NSS和VLM嵌入的贡献；结合MSE、PLCC和成对排序目标的混合损失训练，无需端到端微调VLM骨干。

Result: KonIQ-10k: SROCC=0.9142, PLCC=0.9279; KADID-10k: SROCC=0.9715, PLCC=0.9733 (超越SOTA); LIVE Challenge: SROCC=0.8527, PLCC=0.8802。门控权重与独立消融实验测量的NSS贡献呈正相关(Spearman ρ=0.33)。

Conclusion: NSS在噪声、色偏等直接改变像素统计的失真类型上贡献最大，在颜色饱和度变化等感知失真上贡献最小；模型通过门控机制自主发现了与手动失真分析一致的流-失真亲和模式。

Abstract: Blind image quality assessment (BIQA) aims to predict perceived image quality without access to a reference image. Classical natural scene statistics (NSS) descriptors and modern vision-language model (VLM) embeddings address this problem from fundamentally different perspectives, yet whether combining them yields complementary benefits and how to weight their contributions per input image remains unexplored. We propose a distortion-aware fusion framework that integrates a 138-dimensional NSS descriptor with two complementary VLM embeddings, SigLIP and CLIP-H, through a multiplicative gating mechanism that learns per-input stream weights conditioned on image content. Unlike static concatenation fusion, the proposed gating network suppresses or amplifies each stream's contribution based on the input, producing weights that correlate positively (Spearman rank correlation rho=0.33) with the per-distortion NSS contribution measured by independent ablation on KADID-10k. The framework requires no end-to-end fine-tuning of the VLM backbones and is trained with a hybrid loss combining mean squared error, Pearson linear correlation, and pairwise ranking objectives. We evaluate on three standard benchmarks: KonIQ-10k (SROCC=0.9142, PLCC=0.9279), KADID-10k (SROCC=0.9715, PLCC=0.9733, surpassing recent state-of-the-art methods), and LIVE Challenge in-the-Wild (SROCC=0.8527, PLCC=0.8802 with cross-dataset pretraining and fine-tuning). A per-distortion analysis on KADID-10k reveals that NSS features contribute most on noise and color-shift distortions where pixel statistics are directly affected, and least on perceptual distortions such as color saturation changes. The learned gate values validate these findings, confirming that the model autonomously discovers distortion-stream affinity patterns consistent with the manual per-distortion study.

</details>


### [234] [PerBite: A Curated Diagnostic Workflow for Bite-Aware Food Volume Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02021)
*Ahmad AlMughrabi,Farid Al-Areqi,David Fernández Gómez,Umair Haroon,Marc Bolaños,Ricardo Marques,Petia Radeva*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了PerBite方法，用于从视觉上合理的食物网格估计食物体积。该方法在MetaFood挑战赛中排名第一，平均Chamfer距离为8.31，状态级体积MAPE为33.87%，但消耗体积MAPE为53.74%。研究表明表面重建、度量尺度、网格清理、水密体积积分和物理消耗一致性应分别评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究视觉上合理的食物网格是否能够可靠地用于估计已消耗食物的体积。

Method: 采用精选重建协议：SAM 3分割食物和盘子区域；Hunyuan3D/SAM 3D生成无量纲食物网格；利用盘子直径提供度量尺度；在Blender中移除盘子几何；对剩余网格进行孔洞填充、水密化并积分估计体积。MoGe-2仅作为辅助线索用于初始盘径估计。

Result: 在MetaFood挑战赛34个网格上平均Chamfer距离8.31，排名第一；17对前后配对数据上状态级体积MAPE为33.87%，零单调性违规，消耗体积MAPE为53.74%。

Conclusion: 表面重建、度量尺度、网格清理、水密体积积分和物理消耗一致性在膳食评估中应分别评估。

Abstract: Can a visually plausible food mesh be trusted to estimate the volume of consumed food? \method investigates this question using selected paired before- and after-consumption states from the MetaFood CVPR 2026 Continuous 3D Reconstruction While Eating Challenge. The submitted workflow follows a curated reconstruction protocol: SAM~3 segments the food and plate regions; Hunyuan3D/SAM~3D generates a dimensionless food mesh; the plate diameter provides the metric scale; the plate geometry is removed in Blender; and the remaining mesh is hole-filled, made watertight, and integrated to estimate volume. MoGe-2 is used only as an auxiliary cue for initial dish-diameter estimation when direct plate measurement is uncertain; it is not the primary scale source for the reported challenge result. \method ranks first, with an average Chamfer distance of 8.31 across 34 meshes using rigid ICP without scale correction. On 17 before- and after-pairs, it achieves 33.87\% state-level volume MAPE and zero monotonicity violations, while consumed-volume MAPE remains 53.74\%. The results show that surface reconstruction, metric scale, controlled mesh cleanup, watertight volume integration, and physical depletion consistency should be evaluated separately for dietary assessment. Source code and evaluation scripts will be available at \href{https://github.com/GCVCG/PerBite-CVPR-MetaFood-2026}{github.com/GCVCG/PerBite-CVPR-MetaFood-2026}.

</details>


### [235] [Ranking vs. Assignment: The Metric Mismatch in Multi-View Object Association](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02022)
*Matvei Shelukhan,Timur Mamedov,Aleksandr Chukhrov,Karina Kvanchiani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 多视角目标关联中常用的AP和FPR-95指标与实际的分配目标存在根本性不匹配，本文通过理论和实验证明这种不一致性，并提出Sinkhorn归一化作为后处理来揭示这一问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作广泛使用AP和FPR-95等成对排序指标评估多视角目标关联模型，但这些指标与任务本质（约束的一对一匹配）存在根本性不匹配，需要系统性地揭示并分析这一问题。

Method: 1. 理论分析证明AP和FPR-95在分配正确时仍可能不完美，而Sinkhorn归一化可使它们完美；反之，最优成对排序仍可能导致错误分配。2. 使用Sinkhorn归一化作为受控后处理压力测试，仅优化少量后处理参数。

Result: 仅优化少量后处理参数就能显著提升AP和FPR-95，但在ACC和IPAA等分配级指标上并无相应改善，验证了指标不匹配的存在。

Conclusion: 当前广泛使用的AP和FPR-95指标与多视角目标关联的分配目标不一致，评估时应更多关注分配级指标而非仅依赖成对排序指标。

Abstract: Multi-view object association is an important computer vision problem that underlies many multi-camera perception tasks. While this task is naturally formulated as a constrained one-to-one matching problem, recent works heavily rely on pairwise ranking metrics like AP and FPR-95 for model evaluation. We highlight a fundamental mismatch between these metrics and the actual assignment objective. Theoretically, we show that AP and FPR-95 can be imperfect even when the assignment is already correct, and that Sinkhorn-based normalization can make them perfect. Conversely, optimal pairwise ranking can still lead to incorrect assignments. We validate this mismatch in practice by using our Sinkhorn-based normalization as a controlled post-processing stress test. We show that optimizing just a few post-processing parameters significantly boosts AP and FPR-95 without corresponding improvements in assignment-level metrics such as ACC and IPAA.

</details>


### [236] [Normality-Preserving Continual Industrial Anomaly Detection via Orthogonal LoRA Banks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02042)
*Weibai Fang,Haijun Che,Feiyang Ren,Qiancheng Lao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于历史冻结正交LoRA库（HF-OLB）和分层新颖性自适应库增长（HNABG）的无损常态持续异常检测框架，通过将新任务残差约束在历史LoRA子空间的正交补空间上，并依据残差新颖性动态扩展库容量，有效解决了持续异常检测中历史常态先验漂移和灾难性遗忘问题，在MVTec和VisA数据集上取得了SOTA结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续扩散方法通过重放或约束优化保留先验知识，但缺乏显式机制来隔离和保护类别特定的常态先验；标准LoRA虽提供模块化残差更新，但既未冻结历史常态子空间，也无法防止新适配器干扰旧适配器。

Method: 提出HF-OLB（冻结预训练U-Net骨干和已学习的LoRA库，将新任务特定常态残差约束到历史LoRA子空间的正交补空间）和HNABG（分配层依赖的残差容量，仅在残差常态新颖性超出现有库表达容量时扩展库）。

Result: 在MVTec和VisA数据集上验证有效，VisA 2x6设置下达到83.6/91.8图像和像素级A-AUROC，3.8/3.9 FM，像素级A-AUROC提升3.2点，像素级FM降低1.3。

Conclusion: 该方法能有效在长时域持续类别序列中保留历史常态先验，优于现有方法。

Abstract: Continual industrial anomaly detection with diffusion models suffers from historical normality prior drift and catastrophic forgetting. Existing continual diffusion methods preserve previous knowledge through replay or constrained optimization, but they lack an explicit mechanism for isolating and protecting category-specific normality priors during sequential adaptation. Although low-rank adaptation provides modular residual updates, standard LoRA neither freezes historical normality subspaces nor prevents new adapters from interfering with previous ones. To address this issue, we propose a normality-preserving continual anomaly detection framework based on two modules: History Frozen Orthogonal LoRA Bank (HF-OLB) and Hierarchical Novelty Adaptive Bank Growth module (HNABG). HF-OLB freezes both the pre-trained U-Net backbone and the learned LoRA banks, and constrains new task-specific normality residuals to the orthogonal complement of historical LoRA subspaces. HNABG further allocates layer-dependent residual capacity and expands the bank only when the residual normality novelty exceeds the expressive capacity of existing banks. Extensive experiments on MVTec and VisA demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. On the challenging VisA 2x6 setting, our method achieves 83.6/91.8 image and pixel level A-AUROC with 3.8/3.9 FM, improving pixel level A-AUROC over the state of the art by 3.2 points while reducing pixel level FM by 1.3. These results show that our method effectively preserves historical normality priors in long horizon continual category sequences.

</details>


### [237] [Attention mechanisms and transfer learning for robust peach leaf damage classification under domain shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02045)
*Adrián Cánovas-Rodriguez,Miguel A. González-Illán,Maria Fernanda García-Cruz,Pedro Nortes Tortosa,José Salvador Rubio-Asensio,Miguel A. Zamora Izquierdo,Juan Antonio Martínez Navarro,Antonio F. Skarmeta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习的桃树叶部损伤分类方法，使用EfficientNet架构结合CBAM注意力机制，在公开数据集上达到93.3%准确率，并通过迁移学习在本地数据集上实现93%的宏F1分数，展示了模型在不同田间条件下的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候变化加剧了桃园的 abiotic胁迫和生物胁迫，病虫害导致的叶部症状视觉相似，人工诊断困难且难以跨田块泛化，因此需要开发具有强泛化能力的自动化损伤检测模型。

Method: 构建了包含1,366张桃叶图像、6类损伤类别的基准数据集；评估多种深度学习架构（EfficientNet、DenseNet等）；集成CBAM注意力模块提升性能；针对本地小数据集（180张、4类）采用三种微调策略进行迁移学习以应对域偏移。

Result: EfficientNetB0准确率92.9%，EfficientNetB3 91.5%，DenseNet121 92.6%；CBAM增强的EfficientNetB5达到最佳准确率93.3%；迁移学习后EfficientNetB3+CBAM在本地数据集上取得93%宏F1分数。

Conclusion: 基于注意力的模型对少数类具有更好的鲁棒性，并且在不同的田间条件下表现出更强的泛化能力，验证了深度学习方法用于桃树叶部损伤自动诊断的可行性。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence provides a practical framework for crop damage assessment from imagery data, supporting early decision-making in agricultural management. In peach orchards, climate change increases abiotic stress and biotic pressures, including pests and diseases, which often produce visually similar foliar symptoms. This overlap makes manual diagnosis difficult, especially across multiple fields with varying environmental conditions, highlighting the need for automated models with strong generalization ability.
  We propose an image-based classification approach for peach leaf damage detection. A benchmark dataset was created through manual annotation of publicly available images, consisting of 1,366 peach leaves across six damage categories. Several deep learning architectures were evaluated. EfficientNet models achieved the best results, with EfficientNetB0 reaching 92.9 percent accuracy, EfficientNetB3 achieving 91.5 percent, and EfficientNetB5 showing the strongest performance on minority classes. DenseNet121 reached 92.6 percent accuracy. The integration of the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) improved performance in several backbones, particularly EfficientNetB5 and InceptionV3, while showing limited or negative impact in others. The CBAM-enhanced EfficientNetB5 achieved the best overall accuracy of 93.3 percent.
  To evaluate robustness under realistic conditions, a local dataset of 180 images across four classes was collected, and transfer learning strategies were applied to address domain shift. Three fine-tuning strategies were tested. EfficientNetB3 combined with CBAM achieved the best performance in the local domain, reaching a 93 percent macro F1-score after transfer. Overall, attention-based models showed improved robustness for minority classes and better generalization across different field conditions.

</details>


### [238] [TIDES: Time-Derivative Event Simulation via Deformable Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02058)
*Christopher Thirgood,Dipon Kumar Ghosh,Simon Hadfield*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TIDES是一种基于动态高斯泼溅的连续时间事件相机模拟器，通过显式3D场景表示实现精确的阈值交叉预测，并利用遮挡感知自适应时间步进和有限传感器带宽建模，在事件流保真度和下游任务迁移效果上达到最佳水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事件相机模拟器大多从帧序列推断事件时间戳，导致大量阈值交叉共享少数离散时间点（时间戳批处理问题），在快速运动和遮挡情况下尤为严重。真实世界事件数据集稀缺，亟需高保真模拟方案。

Method: 1) 基于动态高斯泼溅构建连续时间事件模拟器，从显式3D场景表示中直接推导每像素强度动态，而非通过渲染帧差分；2) 利用3D场景模型识别局部遮挡区域，指导自适应时间步进，仅在遮挡区域集中计算资源；3) 采用瓦片级仲裁器建模有限传感器带宽，再现吞吐量、抖动和事件丢失等真实传感器伪影。

Result: 在RGB-事件配对基准上，TIDES在事件流保真度上达到最先进水平；TIDES模拟的事件在真实下游任务上的迁移效果优于竞争方法。

Conclusion: TIDES通过连续时间建模和显式3D场景表示有效解决了时间戳批处理问题，结合遮挡感知自适应步进和传感器带宽建模，大幅提升了事件模拟的真实性和下游任务迁移能力。

Abstract: Event cameras emit asynchronous events in response to environmental appearance changes. The scarcity of real-world event datasets makes simulation essential. However, most simulators infer event timestamps from frame sequences, forcing many threshold crossings to share a small set of discrete times; a failure mode we term timestamp batching that worsens under fast motion and occlusion.
  We present TIDES, a continuous-time event simulator built on dynamic Gaussian splatting. Because TIDES operates on an explicit 3D scene representation with learnt geometry and motion, it can derive per-pixel intensity dynamics directly from the scene, rather than by differencing rendered frames. This enables accurate threshold-crossing prediction, including multiple crossings per rendering step, without temporal upsampling or frame interpolation.
